podcast.title: Hybrid Crossing into Alternative World
podcast.body: Jurassic 5 was mentioned as one of the blends and variations of rap music that crossed over "at least the fringes of the alternative world." "We had Jurassic 5, a tribe called Quest, Wu-Teng, Da-Lasoul, Dream Warriors."
